title: ‘Pretend That I Am Running’: 7 Takeaways From the G.O.P. Midterm Convention
summary: At a first-of-its-kind midterm convention, President Trump mostly offered retreads and self-congratulation. Then, he offered to pay Americans $5,000 apiece if Republicans kept power.
